declaration.question: Does each operating strategy, unchanged, earn a cost-adjusted positive result in paper with acceptable drawdown, divergence and operational reliability?

observed_before_freeze.note: thresholds below were set from development frequency and risk, not from these rows; no metric of these rows was computed before this freeze

declaration.scope: operational paper gate for A and E; it does not replace or define the E-MAX forward promotion gate (E_MAX_F0 section 13), which stays NOT DEFINED until its own contract

evidence_book.STRATEGY_A: PAPER_DB account of the active runtime
evidence_book.STRATEGY_E_MAX_V1: OFFICIAL_KIWOOM_PAPER only; PROVISIONAL_RVOL_BOOTSTRAP is never counted

common.operating_session: a scheduled XNYS session on which the strategy's runtime was expected to decide (A: a daily performance row; E: a session record)
common.error_session: A: none recorded by this layer (runtime incidents are entered by the operator); E: session phase ERROR, or NO_DECISION caused by missing data (not a legitimate no-candidate day)

accounting.single_convention: all trades evaluated together must share one accounting convention; a mix is INCONCLUSIVE (ACCOUNTING_MIXED) until the rows are restated by an explicit, separate decision
accounting.TOTAL_COST_DEDUCTED_V0: conservative (charges spread and slippage twice): a PASS under V0 stands, a PnL-based FAIL under V0 is not final and reads INCONCLUSIVE (ACCOUNTING_V0_OVERCHARGED)
accounting.CASH_CHARGES_ONLY_V1: cash-true: PASS and FAIL are both final

common.no_change_on_result: none of these thresholds, and no A or E rule, may change in response to paper results; a change is a new contract version evaluated on sessions after its own freeze

divergence.metric: share of evaluated sessions whose paper entry decision differs from the recorded-session replay (A paper/backtest true parity differential)
divergence.source: external: A parity runner; PENDING until supplied

STRATEGY_A.rationale: A paper traded 3 times in its first 14 sessions and the A V2 baseline 37 times over two years; 30 trades is the smallest sample on which PF and expectancy mean anything, so A may stay INCONCLUSIVE for months. A risks a fixed fraction per trade, and its V2 baseline MDD was 2.94%, so 8% is a failure, not noise.

divergence.metric: mean over completed sessions of (paper session return - the session's recorded net_10bp fixed-cost view)
divergence.source: computed from E engine session summaries

STRATEGY_E_MAX_V1.rationale: E-MAX V1 development traded about one session in two with up to three names at 2.0x/3.0x exposure; its 10bp development MDD was -29.9%, so -30% is the ceiling, and 60 trades is about 30 active sessions. Divergence allows realised costs 20bp per session worse than the 10bp development scenario before it fails.
